gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of GBM based on World Health Organization (WHO) classification of central nervous system (CNS) tumors, 5th edition

candidate_evidence.quote: preliminary efficacy of RO7428731 administered as a monotherapy in participants with newly diagnosed or recurrent epidermal growth factor receptor variant III (EGFRvIII)-positive glioblastoma (GBM).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: participants with newly diagnosed or recurrent epidermal growth factor receptor variant III (EGFRvIII)-positive glioblastoma (GBM).

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: An Open-label, Multicenter, Phase I Study Evaluating the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Preliminary Clinical Activity of RO7428731 in Participants With Glioblastoma Expressing Mutant Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Variant III

role_evidence.quote: preliminary efficacy of RO7428731 administered as a monotherapy

source_quote.quote: Participants (in Part II): Adult participants with newly diagnosed EGFRvIII-positive GBM with unmethylated MGMT promotor status who have completed standard of care therapy with surgical resection and adjuvant radiotherapy with or without concomitant temozolomide.

coder_notes: EGFRvIII expression is an entry requirement for the single investigational agent; the record does not state RO7428731's mechanism, but the trial is built around EGFRvIII-positive GBM and excludes prior anti-EGFRvIII agents, so candidate_matched coded true (drug class from outside drug knowledge in drug_class_hint only). MGMT unmethylated status is required for Part II (Part I accepts either status), coded enrichment for Part II. Pharmacodynamics are a stated objective in title and summary without sample details; coded target_engagement yes. PK in serum only. Temozolomide/radiotherapy are prior therapy, not study treatment. Multiple experimental cohorts, none acting as control.
